verdict.rationale: First-party SQL reference documents native window functions for running totals, moving averages and rankings. It also documents VARIANT/OBJECT/ARRAY as first-class SQL types for JSON and arrays, with built-in query functions and no extensions required. Community evidence notes one analytical gap: there is no generate_series equivalent, only a constants-only generator function. Missing for 10: no evidence of CTE support, no evidence of rich date/time types, a confirmed generate_series gap, and no independent hands-on corroboration of the window and semi-structured features.
